source: docs/ACCEPTANCE_TESTS.md §8 (preview column); IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN Task 13 'Cut 1 release gate' and Task 18
verdict_reason: B1: no certified inference route and no live host certification, so the live comparative smoke, the live workload days, live extraction quality and live delivery certification have not run; a scripted/recorded run is never a pass

items.detail: Every deterministic suite passes locally on Python 3.12/3.13/3.14 and in CI on Linux, macOS and Windows (see the Task 18 checkpoint); the manifest maps every one of the 67 preview IDs and their §2.1 partial variants to existing tests. No case is marked passed: several preview variants include live-host parts (A27, A28, A29, A30, A61, A67 and the live delivery paths) that need B1.

Request-capture isolation passes on the installed Claude Code CLI (clean and host-marked parents); the live route, the operator attestation and the live nonce certification of start/prompt (and the optional pre-action/compaction paths) have not run.
items.blocker: B1: route and attestation not configured; live echo not run

items.detail: The live 12-scenario comparative smoke has not run. The scripted/recorded run (mechanics only) is in docs/evaluations/preview-recorded-2026-10-21/ with its unmet expectations stated; preview may only be published as an explicitly experimental build until the live gate passes.
items.blocker: B1 (no live trial); recorded run shows unmet smoke expectations (see the report)

items.detail: Deterministic and kill/restart suites pass for backup, verified restore, forgetting with suppression-aware restore, pin-aware retention (with derived revision-body aging), the operator-command guard and cross-installation isolation; the scripted §6.1 demonstrations reproduce forgetting/restore and isolation end to end. Migration/upgrade and transfers are full-only.

tools/build_release.py checks the runtime closure of requirements.lock with each package's declared license against docs/release/DEPENDENCIES.json, the wheel's contents against src/recalith, and the absence of foreign copyright headers (no upstream source is adapted, so no THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md ships). The project's own license is not declared in pyproject.toml: that is an owner decision and a publication blocker, recorded under release_artifacts.

docs/OPERATIONS.md separates automatic operation, fallback operation (each degraded condition with what still works and its status reason) and missing capabilities (the 16 deferred features and the other full-only forms).

The report format carries unsuccessful runs, all seven §5.2 measures, the observed native-memory setting, scenario authorship, pilot status and the §6.2 arithmetic labeled as illustrative, actual costs, limitations and no superiority claim; the recorded run's report is checked into docs/evaluations/. The live report is pending B1.
All five Review focus items rechecked at the Task 18 gate, with the cross-component tests rerun (see the Task 18 checkpoint in docs/BUILD_PROGRESS.md).
focus_items: same source event twice across a crash: one support root, one effect
quoted or repeated through agent memory: no added authority or corroboration
correction or forget before the final delivery fence: old guidance excluded, in-flight emission bounded
paths across Windows, worktrees and relocation: only registered boundaries
provider or host version change: capability rechecked, no silent autonomy claim

items.detail: Reported explicitly: the fast-path import audits (tests/platform/test_hook_imports.py), private-path restriction coverage (probed_limited on the installed host; preview installs none), the three default-budget workload days (recorded mode, with the input-estimate pool exhaustion they show) and fresh post-forget recovery (the post-forget verified backup and the forget/restore kill/restart matrix).
recalith status / health(ctx) report release_profile claude_preview, every required and optional capability with its reason, and these 16 deferred features unavailable with deferred_full_release.

tools/measure_release_latency.py runs the §7 populations per native platform (Linux in this container; macOS and Windows on their CI runners through .github/workflows/measure.yml); the results are recorded in docs/measurements/ and the Task 18 checkpoint.
Every kill/restart family at RECALITH_CRASH_REPS=20 (100 is for a release candidate, which this is not).
tools/build_release.py and .github/workflows/release.yml build the wheel and sdist with SHA-256 digests and a release manifest. They are unsigned, and nothing is tagged or published.
items.blocker: signing needs operator material (a signing key or attestation identity) and the project license is undeclared; publication needs the owner's go-ahead
